# `rapids`

GPU processing with rapids-singlecell: optional cell filtering, PCA, optional Harmony, neighbors, UMAP, Leiden, optional parameter scan

- Wrapper: [`job_rapids.sh`](https://github.com/dr-michael-haley/imcanalysis/blob/main/SLURM_scripts/job_rapids.sh)
- Conda environment: `rapids_singlecell`
- Python module: `SpatialBiologyToolkit.scripts.basic_process_rapids`

## Inputs

- rapids.input_adata_path (fallback: general.anndata_path)
- rapids.batch_correction_obs must exist in AnnData.obs when rapids.run_harmony=true
- rapids.filter_obs_key plus optional rapids.filter_min_value/filter_max_value filters cells after load

## Outputs

- rapids.output_adata_path (default general.anndata_path)
- outputs/<execution_id>_RAPIDS_Processing/ figures, tables, and parameter scans

## Configuration

- general, rapids, visualization, logging

## Run

From the dataset directory containing `config.yaml`:

```bash
pl rapids
```
